thread:
Morgan: paging: I'm getting paged by incident-bot for a canary spike in 5xxs against routing-service. Alert: canary-requests > 5% 5xx over 5m :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Pager duty triggered for oncall-sre (Morgan). Incident id: INC-2546. Auto-notifications sent to #incidents and #eng-runtime.
Morgan: looking at graphs now — p50 ok, p95 really high, errors are 502 from upstream model-proxy.
Kai: on it. rolling up logs from the canary hosts. any recent release?
Sam: started a canary of model-routing v2 at 09:14 UTC. commit 0a1b2c3 pushed as single-commit change to traffic-split logic.
Lina: CS flagged a dedicated customer complaining about frequent timeouts in their production region.
Morgan: okay I see a correlation — canary nodes started returning 502 around 09:17, traffic split was set to 10%.
Kai: reproducing locally with traffic-split=10% — hitting model-proxy memory growth and occasional 502s due to KV cache thrash.
Raj: customer impact? which tenants are affected?
Lina: two customers in EU-west on Dedicated saw 5-10% request failures, reported increased tail latency. No data exfiltration.
Morgan: severity: P1 for those customers, page goes to oncall. I'll trigger a kill-switch on the feature flag for routing-v2.
Sam: please also prepare a single-commit revert in case kill-switch doesn't stabilize.
Morgan: flipping flag now -> `feature-flag set routing-v2.enable false --env prod`
incident-bot: Feature flag routing-v2.enable set to false by Morgan at 09:27 UTC. Notifying rollout systems.
Morgan: traffic immediately falling back to routing-v1, errors dropping back toward baseline. p95 improving.
Kai: good. but we should still revert the commit and push a hotfix — the change introduced an unsafe interaction with KV eviction. I'll craft a revert and small patch to guard the cache.
Sam: agree. revert commit id: 0a1b2c3 using `git revert --no-commit 0a1b2c3 && git commit -m "revert: routing-v2 quick rollback"` then bump canary to test later.
Kai: I'll open the PR and attach test harness logs. preparing patch now.
Morgan: oncall -> handing over to Kai for active mitigation, I'll stay on-call until rollback validated.
Kai: deploying hotfix to canary: `kubectl apply -f routing-hotfix.yml --record` then `kubectl rollout status deployment/routing-service -n inference`.
incident-bot: Deploy started by Kai for routing-service/hotfix. Canary set to 5% on 3 hosts.
Lina: looping in affected account managers, sending customer note: "We're seeing elevated errors due to a recent routing change; we've rolled back the change and pushed a hotfix. We'll follow up with RCA."
Sam: once rollback is in prod, let's coordinate a post-deploy watch window (30m) and then a canary re-test with tightened mem caps.
Kai: rollback complete on canary and prod. `kubectl rollout undo` applied to the single offending commit; image tag rolled back to v1.21.4.
Morgan: monitoring: SLOs restored, errors back to baseline. marking incident as mitigated.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2546 status changed to Mitigated by Morgan at 09:48 UTC. Paging cleared.
Lina: customer update sent with temporary mitigation details and ETA for full remediation post-RCA. CS will escalate if they see more issues.
Sam: documenting the change: will cut a tiny hotfix release that adds a guard to the cache eviction and a config knob to cap concurrent cache shards. PR #1529 in review.
Kai: note for postmortem — root cause: unsafe cache invalidation in routing-v2 when traffic split < 20% under sustained concurrent KV updates; reproducer attached in PR.
Morgan: handoff: I'm marking the incident as stable, passing to Kai for follow-up and RCA. I'll rotate off duty in 15 mins.
Raj: thanks all. action items: 1) Kai to finalize PR and ship hotfix, 2) Sam to update deployment checklist to include memory cap tests for routing experiments, 3) Lina to follow up with customers and confirm no ongoing degradation.
Kai: ack. also scheduling a canary test with chaos toggle to exercise low-traffic split.
Sam: once PR merges, I'll run a quick canary surge and then merge to prod. I'll post a deployment note to #eng-releases.
Morgan: closing incident thread but keeping record for postmortem. great triage everyone. :clap:
Raj: opening RCA doc and assigning owners. tentative postmortem meeting tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2546 closed. Postmortem doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2546 (draft).
Kai: small follow-up — sorry for the churn, learned to avoid implicit cache eviction during rollout. will add explicit feature-flag gating around eviction behavior.
Lina: customers acknowledged the update, no escalations.
Sam: adding a short blurb for release notes: "Fixed regression in model routing cache behavior introduced in routing-v2 canary; immediate rollback applied."
